item.title: DJ Whoo Kid Says Rap Game Needs Drake: ‘When He’s Here, We’re on the Charts’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music trends. Today, we're talking about the current state of the rap game. Recently, DJ Whoo Kid shared his thoughts on the genre, and he believes it's missing one key figure: Drake.
[Short music transition]
Host: In an interview with Diverse Mentality, Whoo Kid recalled a moment when Drake reached out to him for permission to use one of his drops on the Kendrick Lamar diss track "Push Ups". He noted that this moment helped introduce his mixtape days to a younger audience and compared it to the battle between Drake and Kendrick Lamar.
[Short music transition]
Host: Whoo Kid emphasized that the rap game needs Drake to return to the charts. He explained that Drake uses patience to his advantage, and when he's present, the charts reflect it. With few notable artists currently on the Billboard Hot 100, Whoo Kid thinks Drake's return is essential to revive the genre.
[Short music transition]
Host: The wait is almost over, though. Drake's ninth solo album, Iceman, is set to drop on May 15. Will his return bring back the excitement to the rap game? We'll have to wait and see.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in. Join us next time for more music news and updates.
